notes: Mexican convenience chain (FEMSA); in Peru: Lima plus Arequipa and Ica (Peru Retail 2024). Default OFF per project config. Store count is a LOWER BOUND and dated: Peru Retail 2024-12-17 says Oxxo 'supera las 200 sucursales en Perú' (as of Nov 2024); no more recent official Peru total was found (Peru Retail 2024-06-11: 166 stores). Official Peru site oxxo.pe shows only an 'en construcción' page (with links to peru.oxxodomicilios.com delivery app and RUC 20602743960); no public store list/locator was found -> storeLocator null. Colours from the logo: red #E70020, yellow #FBB110. OSM (probe 2026-10-01): 48 features, 41 already brand=Oxxo + brand:wikidata=Q1342538 (NSI preset), all shop=convenience except one supermarket. 'Oxxo Gas' fuel stations (amenity=fuel, Mexico brand) are excluded by requiring a shop tag.
